dz: 在访问萨顿城墙的皇家默克里亚宫廷,以与王妃阿尔夫斯里特结婚时被俘并被斩首.
de: While visiting the royal Mercian court at Sutton Walls with a view to marrying princess Ælfthryth, King Æthelberht II of East Anglia is taken captive and beheaded.

t: 日本天皇甘武将其帝国首都迁至平安京（现京都）。
te: Japanese Emperor Kanmu relocates his empire's capital to Heian-kyō (now Kyoto).
dz: 日本天皇甘武将其帝国首都迁至平安京（现京都）。
de: Japanese Emperor Kanmu relocates his empire's capital to Heian-kyō (now Kyoto).
